title: On Reminding the boys of the rule
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：remind　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 remind 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the painter ① reminded the boys of the rule for the whole place, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② reminds the boys of the rule without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ remind the boys of the rule at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reminded the boys of the rule before — a line in the catalogue for May 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reminding the boys of the rule for the whole place, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ remind everybody of that winter without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Remind everybody of that winter at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ reminds everybody of that winter for the whole place every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reminded the boys of the rule again when nobody else would.

⑩ To remind the boys of the rule, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody reminds the boys of the rule without a word of thanks again and somebody must remind the boys of the rule for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 提醒（一般过去式 reminded the boys of the rule：1955 年画师头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 提醒（一般现在 reminds the boys of the rule：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 提醒（不定式 to remind the boys of the rule：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 提醒（过去完成时 had reminded the boys of the rule：1949 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 提醒（动名词 reminding the boys of the rule 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使想起（remind everybody of that winter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使想起让人人都想起那个冬天）
G. v. 使想起（remind everybody of that winter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 提醒（后段两处：新来的观者照例 reminds everybody of that winter，而母亲又一次 reminded the boys of the rule）

answers.why: remind 意为“提醒”，1955 年画师替所有人提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reminded。
remind 意为“提醒”，自那以后画师不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reminds。
remind 意为“提醒”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩”，此处为不定式 to remind the boys of the rule。
remind 意为“提醒”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人提醒过，故用过去完成时 had reminded。
remind 意为“提醒”，画师说“提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reminding the boys of the rule 作主语。
remind 意为“使想起”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使想起让人人都想起那个冬天”，should ever 之后用原形 remind everybody of that winter。
remind 意为“使想起”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使想起让人人都想起那个冬天（remind everybody of that winter at once），以后再也不要提起。
remind 意为“提醒”，新来的观者每个季度都照例使想起让人人都想起那个冬天，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reminds。
remind 意为“提醒”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩，用一般过去式 reminded 叙述。
remind 意为“提醒”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，画师替所有人提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩；画室里每一个观者都说这是头一回。（reminded the boys of the rule）
多年以后，画师仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（reminds the boys of the rule）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩这件事本身。（to remind the boys of the rule）
早在 1949 年就有人提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩，五月那天展品目录上的一行字就是证据。（had reminded the boys of the rule）
画师说过，替所有人提醒提醒孩子们那条规矩这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（reminding the boys of the rule 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻使想起让人人都想起那个冬天，以后再也不要提起。（remind everybody of that winter，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 remind 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the painter reminded the boys of the rule for the whole place, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter reminds the boys of the rule without a word of thanks whenever the studio asks.
Reminding the boys of the rule for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever remind everybody of that winter without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio reminds everybody of that winter for the whole place every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reminded the boys of the rule again, and the studio remembered that half.
